_readme: Level 2: Something Does Not Match. One client (Aling Rosa Santos), one case.
caseIds: case files in Levels/Level_02/cases, in play order. case_001/case_002 are old placeholder copies, kept on disk but no longer played.
officeFeatures: shared office systems Office_Level2 uses (hud, minimap, guide, fade, finale). Office_Level1 always has all of them. Remove one to switch it off here.
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.
